:::{#def-distributive}
#### Distributive law

An operation $\star$ on a set $S$ **distributes over** an operation $\diamond$ on $S$
(@def-identity-element)
if

$$a \star (b \diamond c) = (a \star b) \diamond (a \star c)$$

for all $a, b, c \in S$.
The **distributive law** is the statement that multiplication distributes over addition,
$a \times (b + c) = (a \times b) + (a \times c)$ (@thm-mult-distr);
we then say multiplication is **distributive**.

:::
